candidates.source_name: Prozorro national web portal — tender search (Пошук закупівель)
candidates.why_relevant: Official public front-end of Ukraine's central e-procurement database. Free-text + CPV (ДК 021:2015) filtered search over every above-threshold tender notice, bid and award decision, including banking services, ATMs, self-service terminals, POS and card processing. Highest-value pointer in the cell: enumerates buyer and supplier legal names that seed every other cell.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the CDB REST API rather than scraping the SPA; use the UI only for manual triage and permalink resolution (https://prozorro.gov.ua/tender/{UA-ID}).

candidates.source_name: Prozorro Central Database public REST API (CDB, OpenProcurement API 2.5)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable system of record. Paginated change-feed over all tenders, plans, contracts and awards with CPV classification, buyer/supplier EDRPOU identifiers, values, dates and document attachments. This is the backbone for automated, repeatable enumeration of every UA banking/payments public purchase.

candidates.legal_status: open data, free reuse with attribution

Mirror /plans, /contracts, /agreements similarly.

negative_findings.description: No official bulk data dump / full-archive export endpoint for the Prozorro CDB was located. Searches for public.docs.openprocurement.org, public.api.openprocurement.org and an OCDS mirror returned only a legacy reference to ocds.prozorro.openprocurement.io, which is old and could not be confirmed as current.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the incremental REST change-feed (public-api.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/...) and the data.gov.ua CKAN dataset were confirmed as bulk-ish routes; no single downloadable archive was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A full historical backfill of banking/payments tenders will require a long paginated crawl of the change feed rather than a one-shot download; collection effort and runtime must be planned accordingly.

negative_findings.description: The openprocurement.api overview page does not state the production API host, sandbox host, authentication requirements for read access, or rate limits.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetched https://prozorro-api-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html — it defines only JSON/UTF-8 conventions. Host names (public-api.prozorro.gov.ua, api.prozorro.gov.ua) were inferred from live document URLs seen in search results, not from a documentation statement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Base URL and rate-limit assumptions are unconfirmed; a collector built on them must be defensive (backoff, 429 handling) and the hosts must be validated by the deterministic liveness pass.

negative_findings.description: Local-language searching for BI Prozorro analytics specifically covering payment terminals / ATMs returned no ready-made category dashboard.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched 'bi.prozorro.org аналітика модуль закупівлі платіжні термінали' — results covered the BI module generally (how to use it, who built it) but no banking/payments category cut exists as a published view.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Category sizing for banking/payments must be produced by us from CPV-filtered raw data; there is no authoritative third-party category baseline to lean on or cross-check against.

negative_findings.description: A distinct host 'market.prozorro.gov.ua' for Prozorro Market was searched for but never observed in results; the e-catalogue is presented under the main portal path /ProzorroMarket and via broker sites.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence found for a separate market.* hostname. Recorded the portal path instead. Do not assume the market subdomain exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated endpoint entering the source register; e-catalogue data should be pulled through the CDB API's price-quotation/catalogue families instead.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact ДК 021:2015 (CPV) code allow-list for banking & payments has not been finalised. Codes observed in live tenders so far: 66110000-4 (банківські послуги, incl. acquiring, cash servicing, card accounts), 66170000-2 (обробка фінансових транзакцій, клірингові послуги), 32440000-9 (телеметричне та термінальне обладнання — used for self-service terminals), 72260000-5 (послуги, пов'язані з програмним забезпеченням). The seed's 30123400 was not observed in any real UA notice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Download the ДК021 classifier from prozorroukr.github.io/standards, then build and freeze an allow-list spanning 66xxxxxx (financial/banking), 30xxxxxx (office/data-processing machines), 32440000 (terminal equipment), 48xxxxxx and 72xxxxxx (software/IT services); validate it by back-testing against the four confirmed example tender IDs.

coverage_gaps.description: Much banking/payments demand is misclassified under generic CPV codes and is only findable by free-text title matching (e.g. 'термінал самообслуговування' filed under telemetry equipment, ATM purchases filed under office machinery).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dual filter: CPV allow-list OR uk/en keyword regex over title+description — банкомат, ATM, термінал самообслуговування, POS-термінал, платіжний термінал, еквайринг, процесинг, карткові операції, емісія карток, персоналізація карток, касета, купюроприймач, cash-in, cash recycling, IT-обслуговування банкоматів.

coverage_gaps.description: Purchases below the reporting threshold and those made via the e-catalogue/price quotation are structurally under-represented in the classic tender search, yet ATM/terminal servicing contracts are often small and recurrent.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Include the priceQuotation / e-catalogue procedure families and 'reporting on concluded contract' (звіт про укладений договір) records in the CDB crawl, not just openua/openeu.

coverage_gaps.description: Prozorro's CDB covers public buyers only. Commercial banks that are not state-owned procure outside it; their tenders appear, if at all, in brokers' commercial-procurement sections (SmartTender, Zakupivli.Pro commercial) or nowhere.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over broker commercial-tender sections and treat private-bank demand as a separate cell; do not treat Prozorro coverage as full market coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: Under martial law, defence and certain security-related procurement disclosure rules changed, and some buyer/supplier details may be withheld or delayed. The exact current disclosure regime for banking-adjacent purchases by security-sector buyers was not researched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Read the defence procedure family docs (tendering/defense) and current Infobox guidance on martial-law disclosure before drawing any completeness conclusions from award counts over 2022+.

coverage_gaps.description: Several hosts recorded here (public-api.prozorro.gov.ua, audit-api.prozorro.gov.ua, bi.prozorro.org, bipro.prozorro.org, specifications.prozorro.org, spending.gov.ua) were established from search results, official index pages and live document URLs, but were not individually fetched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic liveness pass verify each; treat any 403/timeout as bot-defence rather than death, and re-check bipro's access tier specifically.

brief: Prozorro is unambiguously the master index for Ukrainian public banking and payments demand: the legal system of record publishes every above-threshold notice, bid and award, and exposes it three ways — the prozorro.gov.ua search UI, the OpenProcurement 2.5 REST change-feed at public-api.prozorro.gov.ua (the only route that scales), and the daily-refreshed BI Prozorro Qlik modules built by Transparency International Ukraine. Around that core sits a well-developed derivative ecosystem — the ДАСУ audit/monitoring API for contested procurements, the Prozorro Market e-catalogue for below-threshold buys, data.gov.ua as the statutory open-data mirror, spending.gov.ua for realised treasury payments, and third-party layers (Clarity Project, DOZORRO, Zakupivli.Pro, SmartTender, dzo.com.ua) that join tenders to company registry data. The main practical risks are not access but recall and scope: relevant purchases hide under generic CPV codes so a keyword layer in Ukrainian is mandatory alongside the ДК 021:2015 allow-list, no bulk archive export was found so backfill means a long paginated crawl, and non-state commercial banks procure entirely outside the system. Real observed codes to anchor the filter set are 66110000-4, 66170000-2, 32440000-9 and 72260000-5; the seed's 30123400 did not appear in any live Ukrainian notice.
